svg.title: How much triangle is left?
svg.desc: At the front triple moment, parameter zero, the three selected offset-25 plane arcs still enclose a thin curved pocket. The left panel uses equal physical coordinate scales: its width is about 0.07002 units and its height about 1.87369. The right panel shows the same pocket after stretching horizontal distances by exactly 25; vertical distances are unchanged. The original area is about 0.0656428042557 square drawing units. Multiplying the area by distance tends to 3375 over 2048. Exact arc integrals certify the area separately from these rounded paths. This is an isolated three-arc model, with no assertion that the full movie has an empty face here.

g.text: At the front’s triple, δ = 0, the three plane arcs still enclose a little pocket.
Gold and lilac: outer arcs · blue: middle circle · offset M = 25
A narrow sliver, at its true proportions.
Vertical distances keep their original scale.
The pocket shrinks as the offset grows.
In the stretched coordinates, its boundaries approach three parabolas.
Integrating between them gives: M × area → 3375/2048 = 1.64794921875.
